At Striker Asphalt and Sealcoating, LLC, we take pride in providing dependable asphalt solutions backed by experience, quality, and customer care. Locally owned and operated, our company is built on hard work, honest communication, and a commitment to doing the job right the first time. We specialize in paving, sealcoating, and crack sealing for residential, commercial, and municipal clients throughout the region.

With years of industry experience, our team understands what it takes to deliver long-lasting results. From the initial estimate to the final layer of asphalt, we bring attention to detail and a no-nonsense approach to every project—big or small. We believe in using proven methods, premium materials, and a hands-on work ethic that shows in the finished product.

At Striker, we’re not just working on asphalt—we’re building trust. That’s why so many of our customers return for future work and refer us to their friends, neighbors, and colleagues.
